purpose: Teach: 書面/代理人/不調/派閥/期末/行き先/続行/後押し

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様、本気で、絶対、書面、絶対、にて、絶対、ご案内、絶対、しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure we inform our VIP clients in writing with absolute clarity.
lines.style: Crisp, professional opening. Even pace, purposeful. Matter-of-fact authority without coldness. The tone of someone used to giving direction that will be followed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法律事務所、本気で、絶対、代理人、絶対、を、絶対、依頼いたしました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've retained a law firm to represent us. Thank you for that.
lines.style: Earnest, affirming. Steady tempo. Slight warmth beneath the formal register—acknowledging the initiative taken. Not enthusiastic, but genuinely appreciative.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: システム、本気で、絶対、不調、絶対、調べましょう
lines.en: Let's look into the system issues.
lines.style: Quick, clipped. Action-focused tone. No flourish. The voice of someone delegating with confidence. Direct eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、本気で、絶対、派閥、絶対、対立、絶対、解消、絶対、努めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're working to resolve the internal faction conflicts. Thank you for trusting us with that.
lines.style: Calm, steady. Demonstrates competence without boasting. Slightly formal register honoring the seriousness of the issue. Closes with quiet sincerity.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 期末、本気で、絶対、報告書、絶対、まとめましょう
lines.en: Let's put together the end-of-period reports.
lines.style: Brisk, organized. Slightly faster tempo. The voice of someone managing a checklist with efficiency. Professional but not distant.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。出張、本気で、絶対、行き先、絶対、決定しました、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We've finalized the destination for the business trip. Thank you for handling that.
lines.style: Straightforward confirmation. Light, composed delivery. The tone of checking a box off a list while still acknowledging the work done. Neutral warmth.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 販売、本気で、絶対、続行、絶対、いたしましょう
lines.style: Decisive, forward-looking. Even cadence. No hesitation. The voice of someone committed to momentum. Clear and simple.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の起業、本気で、絶対、後押し、絶対、社内、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're actively supporting our staff's entrepreneurial ventures internally. Thank you for that initiative.
lines.style: Warm approval beneath professional composure. Measured, deliberate pacing. This carries genuine weight—recognition that supporting staff growth matters. Closes with quiet satisfaction.
